newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow early, becoming active around Noon in the Panhandle Wednesday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting strong inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 16,600 slaughter steers and 12,900 slaughter heifers; 69,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 25,200 formulated and 100 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00 to mostly 68.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 66.00-67.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00 to mostly 68.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 66.00-67.00. Select and Choice 2-4 1000-1200 lbs including heiferettes 62.00-65.00. Confirmed - 29,500 Week Ago - 33,900 Year Ago - 200
Wk to date - 69,500 Week Ago - 57,400 Year Ago - 15,000
